issue.title: Feature: Add support for vision estimate feed
issue.body: This would be a good enhancement for more complex systems

comments.body: @TSC21 can you please give some more details what exactly is needed here. What data and functionality needs to be exposed? What are the underlying mavlink messages?

Sure thing. So the idea would be to interface this with using fast-RTPS as the Pub/Sub framework. A direct OpenCV visual odometry plugin could be written and be taken as an example, but wouldn't actually serve as an interface, but rather as an idea of how OpenCV could be integrated in a visual odometry pipeline.
The underlying Mavlink msgs would be `VISION_POSITION_ESTIMATE` (for pose), `VISUAL_SPEED_ESTIMATE` (for velocity) and `ODOMETRY`, which gives a more complete visual odometry msg.

Thanks! So I don't understand why this would interface to fast-RTPS. So the SDK is supposed to interface to the stable mavlink API (and not the changing, internal uORB/fast-RTPS API).

But so the use case would be to use this to send visino information to the autopilot or get it from the autopilot?

The interface will be between the SDK and fast-RTPS. It doesn't really have to be between fast-RTPS and the PX4 internals. The use case is to use it to send VIO data to the autopilot, parsed from a fast-RTPS publisher.

@julianoes it doesn't have to be mandatory to interface with fast-RTPS, since we could rather use other types of Pub-Sub/message broker frameworks to the same purpose. For example, for the Android case, one can use [`EventBus`](http://greenrobot.github.io/EventBus/). [RabbitMQ](https://www.rabbitmq.com/) has even a [client for Swift](https://github.com/rabbitmq/rabbitmq-objc-client/). It does depend on what message brokers we do want to support.

I'm still confused what the architecture will be.

Which of these do you mean?

1. `autopilot -> fast-RTPS -> SDK`
2. `autopilot -> mavlink -> SDK -> fast-RTPS/RabbitMQ/etc.`
I mean `fast-RTPS/RabbitMQ/etc. -> SDK -> mavlink -> autopilot`, since you will be sending the VIO data to the autopilot, not getting from it.
Ok got it. In this case the SDK does not need to implement any of `fast-RTPS/RabbitMQ/etc` but only provide the API for mavlink which makes sense.

> In this case the SDK does not need to implement any of `fast-RTPS/RabbitMQ/etc` but only provide the API for mavlink which makes sense.

Partially. I mean, if you want to subscribe to published VIO data in the `RabbitMQ` framework, you need to add an handler for that data, right? Creating a transparent agnostic class that handles the subscriptions to these brokers may make sense. Then, the vision plugin would get the data from that interface.
Let me know if you are interested to tackle this together.

> Let me know if you are interested to tackle this together.

I can try to help you if you have questions but I need to work on a couple of other things first like integration tests in CI and the Java wrapper first.
There is support for VISION_POSITION_ESTIMATE in the Mocap plugin.

issue.title: Help, I dont know how to debug LPE
issue.body:
Hello, this is not a bug, Im a newbie and Ive scanned the internet for documentation, but I cant find it, so this is the last place I go for help. Please help.

I am trying to use an external position system (visual odometry) for vision in my SITL using LPE as fuser and Dronekit for communication. I just want to debug the LPE fuser, but I dont know where to do it. I need to check if the PX4 actually receives my position or not. My debug approach so far, has been to see if I get the drone to fall over by spamming the SITL with very noisy vision data using Mavlink-VISION_POSITION_ESTIMATE-messages, but the drone seem to be really stable. I think it is getting nice GPS signals, and sticking to it. So there is no way for me to tell if SITL really receives my vision position or not.

Im using Airsim. 

My params:
LPE_FUSION to only gps and land detector.
LPE_VIS_XY to 0.01
LPE_VIS_Z to 0.01
ATT_EXT_HDG_M 1

So, how can I get the px4 SITL console to print out the VISION position before it gets fused into LPE?

**Update:**
I ment to say I set LPE_FUSION to only gps, land detector and _vision_.
Im using LPE because I read that EKF2 is not supporting vision. Is that right?
